scope.supportedSurface: Core AiService OpenAI-compatible provider with an explicitly configured endpoint and explicit draft action.
scope.fixture: Controlled loopback HTTP listener and fictional message content only.
assertions: AiService construction produced no connection during a 150 ms startup observation window.
An explicit draft used only the configured /configured/chat/completions route.
The POST body contained the exact model, temperature, system instruction, and fictional user context.
The request carried its configured authorization header but no Cookie, Referer, Origin, or API key in the JSON body.
The harness capped one request at 64 KiB and shared a five-second action deadline across draft and server completion.
Draft or server timeout paths abort and await the request task.

sensitivity.mutation: Private candidate changed the OpenAI route to unexpected/chat/completions, then restored it.
sensitivity.result: The configured route assertion failed with exit code 101.
sensitivity.qualification: This route sensitivity run predates the final harness-bound additions, but exercises the unchanged exact route assertion.

core: AiService request construction uses a redirect policy that does not follow redirects.
Existing core tests cover the total request deadline and redirect/error handling.
relatedExistingEvidence.desktop: Native AI commands are disabled by AI_FEATURES_ENABLED=false and have dedicated guard-before-endpoint/process tests.

limitations: The 150 ms check establishes only that construction did not connect during that observation window. It does not prove a lifetime absence of network activity.
This receipt covers the core configured OpenAI-compatible action boundary. It does not establish a native UI, packaged build, real provider, or full-source result.
A LocalCommand provider runs a user-configured executable without an operating-system network sandbox. This receipt makes no local-command egress-isolation claim.
